creator: brooke_wrightmode
title: Four Claude Code plugins before you vibe code: Superpowers (plan/test/debug/review workflow), Graphify (queryable codebase graph), Impeccable (design), and a skills CLI that finds and installs a matching skill

tools.name: Superpowers
tools.detail: README on screen lists skills: verification-before-completion, brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, dispatching-parallel-agents, requesting-code-review, receiving-code-review, using-git-worktrees, finishing-a-development-branch; MIT license

tools.name: Graphify
tools.detail: Maps codebase into a graph you can query before Claude edits; screen shows a node graph with a COMMUNITIES panel (APIRouter, SecurityBase, FastAPI, HTTPException, models, utils, ModelField, PathLike...)

tools.name: Impeccable
tools.detail: README table on screen: /impeccable document (Generate root DESIGN.md from existing project code), extract (pull reusable components and tokens), shape (plan UX/UI before writing code), critique (UX review: hierarchy, clarity, emotional resonance), audit (technical checks a11y, performance, responsive); Apache-2.0

tools.name: skills CLI ('skill cli')
tools.detail: Search for a skill matching the job and install it (likely skills.sh / Vercel find-skills)

claims: Superpowers gives Claude planning, testing, debugging and reviewing workflows
Graphify maps a codebase into a graph you can query before Claude starts editing
Impeccable takes a website from 'AI slop with purple gradients' to something that looks good
The skills CLI searches for a skill matching your task and installs it
how_to_steps: Install Superpowers plugin for the workflow skills
Run Graphify to build a queryable graph of the codebase before edits
Use the skills CLI to search and install task-specific skills
on_screen_only: Pixel-art title '4 Claude Code Plugins for vibecoding'

PLAN / Superpowers README excerpt: 'verification-before-completion - Ensure it's actually fixed'; Collaboration: brainstorming - Socratic design refinement; writing-plans - Detailed implementation plans; executing-plans - Batch execution with checkpoints; dispatching-parallel-agents - Concurrent subagent workflows; requesting-code-review - Pre-review checklist; receiving-code-review - Responding to feedback; using-git-worktrees - Parallel development branches; finishing-a-development-branch - Merge/PR; MIT license

GRAPHIFY / Codebase graph: colored cluster graph with COMMUNITIES list (APIRouter, SecurityBase, v1, FastAPIDeprecationWarning, FastAPI, BaseModelWithConfig, Scope, HTTPException, models, lenient_issubclass, get_typed_signature, utils, ModelField, DefaultPlaceholder, PathLike)
DESIGN / Impeccable README command table (document, extract, shape, critique, audit) plus 'init ... recommend next steps'
Closing: 'COMMENT VIBE for the PLUGIN LIST'
cta: Comment 'vibe' for the links; save and follow

relevance.why: Superpowers' skill list (verification-before-completion, git worktrees, code-review loops) maps well onto a solo founder's workflow, and Impeccable's per-command table is useful; the rest overlaps liked content.

implement_score.why: Try Superpowers (one plugin install) and specifically its verification-before-completion and executing-plans skills; ~30 minutes to evaluate. Graphify is a second-tier trial. Skills CLI is already covered by the liked find-skills video.

verify: Superpowers: exact repo (likely obra/superpowers) and whether it conflicts with existing CLAUDE.md/plan workflows
Graphify: repo name and whether the graph is consulted automatically by Claude Code or must be queried manually
Whether 'skill cli' is skills.sh / Vercel's find-skills (already liked) or something else

gap.what: Impeccable and a skills finder are already liked; new are Superpowers (a workflow plugin with named skills such as verification-before-completion, using-git-worktrees, executing-plans) and Graphify, plus Impeccable's command table (document/extract/shape/critique/audit).
